newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cincinnati Milacron EPS view pared.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cincinnati Milacron EPS view pared.

text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc said Friday it trimmed its 1997 earnings-per-share estimate on Cincinnati Milacron Inc to $2.06 from $2.10.

-- Analyst Walter Liptak in a report said his action reflects the slower-than-expected economy in Europe. However, he added, "With an improving domestic economy and the backlog already expanding, we remain positive on Cincinnati Milacron."
-- Liptak's Q1 estimate is $0.30 a share versus $0.36 a year ago. The down quarter is due to a $3 million pretax charge ($0.05) for European workforce reduction, he said.
